classification: known public OOM behavior; not a new vulnerability or CVE

experiment_policy.build_config: debug for original bounded baseline probes
experiment_policy.note: The 14 MiB case is an input-construction control and must not be interpreted as Base64 output-allocation failure.

candidate_patch.summary: Internal fallible allocation flag private to base64.c; five generic/x86 SIMD allocation sites use safe fallible allocation; userland base64_encode() returns RETURN_OOM() on NULL.
